verdict: Paid ads remain off; five milestones are overdue and being resolved now.
narrative: This period, your business ran entirely on organic Google Business Profile (GBP) traffic — paid ads on Meta and Google have been dark for the full 28 days. GBP delivered 580 total actions including 43 calls, 94 direction requests, and 443 website clicks, though actions dropped sharply in the final days of the window. Five planned milestones — including the ad relaunch, content distribution from the live-cooking shoot, and SEO phase one — passed their due dates without completing, which is the direct cause of the stalled paid channels and near-zero search presence. Each of those items is being worked through this week with clear owners, and ad activity is the immediate priority. Once ads are live and tracking is in place, you'll have a much fuller picture of what's driving results.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions in the last 28 days — your only active traffic channel this period
phone calls driven by your Google Business Profile this period

watch_item.issue: GBP actions fell by more than half week-over-week, with the last three days of the period showing near-zero activity — a hard stop, not a gradual slowdown.
watch_item.fix: The cause is under active review this week, and ad channels are being relaunched to reduce sole dependence on GBP for traffic.
